benefits: > **Pattern of Assistance:** - Unskilled daily wages rate as notified time to time by the U. T. Administration to the families of the Fishermen those are held 1s time captive/detained by Pakistani Marine Security Agency (PMSA), having valid ID Cards and resident of U.T. of Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu. - **T.A./D.A. to the fishermen during the repatriations from Pakistani Jail:-** 1. Travelling Allowance (T.A.) is admissible at 2nd class Sleeper of Railways Fair. 1. Daily Allowance (D.A.) of ₹250/- per day per person is admissible during repatriation. - One time financial Assistance in the form of back ended subsidy to the registered boat owner of the U.T. of Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu to re-construct/ replace their fishing vessels by new fishing vessels @ 25% maximum up to ₹ 10.00 lakh, with waiting period of five years.
detailed_description: The scheme “Financial Assistance to Boat owner / Fishermen Captured by Pakistan Marine Security Agency (PMSA)” has been implemented by the Department of Fisheries, UT Administration of Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu. The scheme aims to help the families of the fishermen affected due to captured by Pakistani Marine Security Agency. Ameliorate the hardship due to apprehension/detention of the fishing vessel, by providing one time back ended financial assistance to the registered and licensed fishing vessel owners operating from the Union Territory to re-construct/replace their fishing boat/engine etc.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of the Union Territory of Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu. 1. The applicant must be a boat owner or fisherman captured by the Pakistan Marine Security Agency (PMSA), or a family member thereof.

en.documentsRequired_md: 1. Identity proof 1. Passport size photograph 1. Residence proof 1. Bank account details 1. Ration Card 1. Any other documents (As per requirement)
